question: Should maintainers repair this draft branch, or choose another Feishu newline PR as the canonical fix for the linked bug?
rationale: This branch has useful tests and edit-limit coverage, but it is conflicting, lacks live Feishu proof, and overlaps multiple open candidate PRs; deterministic cleanup cannot safely choose the canonical branch alone.

options.title: Choose a newer canonical branch
